title: fix(app-shell,console): a plain page route stops loading the Studio designers, InterfaceListPage and one chunk per eager icon (objectui#12187)
body:
Part of #12187
Clause-②: no

Item 2 of objectui#12187, under claim `6119197321` as amended for item 2 by `6121401939`: what a plain page route pulls before its content. Item 1 landed as `54159d3`. Item 3 (one `sys_user_preference` read per load) stays on the card, so this PR leaves the card open.

## The measurement (H0), before and after

**Instrument.** The console's own `vite build` (its `vite.config.ts`, unchanged, plus one scratch plugin that is not committed and dumps rolldown's chunk graph: each chunk's `imports`, `dynamicImports` and modules, and the module graph). Then the built `dist`, served under `/_console/` with an injected base href, in a cold Chromium context (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) on `/_console/apps/demo_app/page/welcome`. The backend is a Playwright route mock: one app whose navigation opens one home-kind page (a `page:header` and a `text` block), signed in as a member without `manage_metadata`. "Before content" means resource entries whose `startTime` precedes the moment the page's text is in the DOM. The resource-timing buffer is raised first: Chromium keeps 250 entries by default, and a full buffer reads as exactly 250, which is the figure the card's staging reading shows.

Before = this branch's base `54159d3`. After = this PR's head. Three cold runs each; the counts were identical across runs.

| reading | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| requests before content | 385 | 102 |
| JS chunks before content | 355 | 72 |
| single-icon `vendor-icon-*` chunks before content | 279 | 0 (one `vendor-icons-shell` chunk) |
| Studio designer and interface-list chunks before content | `register-builtin-designers`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`, `default-inspector-registry`, `InterfaceListPage` | none |
| other `*Inspector*`-named chunks before content | `ViewVariantInspector`, `MetadataInspector` | the same two (see "Not changed here") |
| page text in the DOM, ms after navigation (loopback, shared box) | 1583 / 1499 / 1398 | 1184 / 1180 / 1351 |
| `main` in the DOM, ms | 1320 / 1235 / 1132 | 925 / 926 / 1080 |

The 102 requests after: 72 JS chunks, 27 API calls, 2 stylesheets, 1 favicon. The 27 API calls include the three `sys_user_preference` reads that item 3 is about.

JS chunks before content, after (hash suffixes dropped): `ActionResultDialog`, `app-shell-eager-leaves`, `appRoute`, `AssignedUsersSection`, `assistantBus`, `builtin-designers-loader`, `componentRegistry`, `createDerive`, `CreateViewDialog`, `data-adapter`, `DeclaredActionsBar`, `dist`, `drillUrlFilters`, `ExpressionProvider`, `expressionUser`, `FlowPaletteRecentsProvider`, `FlowRunner`, `framework`, `i18n`, `i18n-locale-en`, `i18n-runtime`, `index`, `infrastructure`, `mergeServerFields`, `MetadataInspector`, `nav-selection`, `ObjectView`, `packagedActions`, `pageKindNode`, `PageView`, `plugin-chatbot`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-view`, `plugins-views`, `preferLocal`, `PreviewModeContext`, `RecordDetailView`, `rolldown-runtime`, `runtime-metadata-persistence`, `RuntimeDraftBar`, `SchemaForm`, `SettingsField`, `SkeletonDetail`, `src`, `studioEntry`, `submitRedirect`, `ui-components`, `ui-layout`, `useActionModal`, `useCanAuthorMetadata`, `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `useDatasetCatalog`, `useMetadata`, `useMetaItemRefusal`, `useNavTargetLabel`, `userFilterUrlState`, `useSettingsLabel`, `useTenancyPosture`, `utils`, `vendor-dndkit`, `vendor-i18n`, `vendor-icons-core`, `vendor-icons-shell`, `vendor-markdown`, `vendor-objectstack`, `vendor-radix`, `vendor-react`, `vendor-react-markdown`, `vendor-ui-utils`, `viewFilterFold`, `ViewVariantInspector`.

Before, the same route loaded 279 single-icon chunks and these 76 others: the list above without `vendor-icons-shell`, `builtin-designers-loader` and `useConsoleActionRuntime`, plus `register-builtin-designers`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`, `default-inspector-registry`, `InterfaceListPage`, `identity` and `apiBase`. (`apiBase` and `useConsoleActionRuntime` are the same shared helpers, written to a chunk of a different name.)

## The edges, each with the module that made it

1. **The designers: a dynamic import that ran on every page load.** `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` ran `import('./views/metadata-admin/register-builtin-designers.js').then(...)` at its own module scope (objectui#11939 step 2). In the graph it is a `dynamicImports` edge of the eager `src` chunk, so the eager-closure gate never weighs it. The browser still fetched it at boot: `register-builtin-designers` and 62 chunks it imports statically (`HookDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`, `default-inspector-registry`, `InterfaceListPage`, `pageKindNode`, `identity` and 56 single-icon chunks). Nothing on a page route reads a designer.
   - **Change:** the entry passes the same loader to `deferBuiltinDesigners` in a new module-internal module, `views/metadata-admin/builtin-designers-loader.ts`. The three designer registries run it once, on their first read: `createObservableTypeRegistry`'s `get` and `types`, and the reader hooks' subscribe. Importing the entry still registers every built-in designer with no call from the host (Ruling A on objectui#11798): `entryRegistersBuiltinDesigners-11939` passes unchanged. A module imported without the entry (a test of one surface) keeps empty registries, as before.
   - The loader sits in its own module because the entry calls it at module scope. A first cut kept it in `preview-registry.ts`, and that put the whole registry module in the eager closure. In the after build the eager closure gains exactly one module, `builtin-designers-loader.ts`, in a 412-byte chunk.
2. **`InterfaceListPage`: a static import in `PageView`.** `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` imported `InterfaceListPage` statically. Its chunk is shared with the Studio's `PagePreview` and with `ObjectDataPage`, so it is a chunk of its own, and that import fetched it on every page route.
   - **Change:** a `React.lazy` edge, rendered under `Suspense` with a spinner, in the `interfaceConfig.source` branch only.
3. **The icons: one chunk per icon by design (objectui#9251).** On the before build, 223 of the 291 eager-closure chunks were single-icon `vendor-icon-*` chunks, each imported statically by an eager chunk. The other 56 single-icon chunks on the route came with edge 1.
   - **Change:** in `apps/console/vite.config.ts`, a `vendor-icons-shell` group with `tags: ['$initial']`, listed after `vendor-icons-core` and before the per-icon group, at the same priority.
   - **Measured on the two builds:** its members are exactly the 223 icons whose per-icon chunk was eager before. The after build's eager closure holds the same 223 icons and no `vendor-icon-*` chunk. Lazy icons keep their own chunks (1592 of them in the after build), so this is not the all-icon aggregate objectui#9251 refused. The lucide runtime stays in `vendor-icons-core` (12 modules on both builds).
   - **`$initial` over-captures, measured:** rolldown decides it before tree-shaking. Without an exclusion the group took 226 icons. The 3 extra are `circle-arrow-up`, `folder-tree` and `webhook`, imported only by `MarketplacePackagePage` and its `PluginDisclosure`. The package barrel re-exports that page and `viteDeclaredLazyViews` marks it side-effect-free, so the bundle keeps it off the eager path. Those three are excluded by name (`LAZY_ONLY_INITIAL_ICONS`), and their chunks are lazy in the after build. The config's note says that nothing re-derives that list.

## Eager closure, from `pnpm check:eager-closure`

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| gzipped | 3,254,971 B (3178.7 KB) | 3,201,712 B (3126.7 KB) |
| raw | 10,948,550 B | 10,899,430 B |
| eager chunks | 291 of 2474 | 70 of 2253 |
| `ui-components` | 281.5 KB | 279.0 KB |

The module set grows by the one loader module and loses none. The bytes that left are gzip-stream overhead (223 streams, now one) and the shorter import lists of the chunks that import the icons. The budget line is untouched.

⚠️ **Headroom** goes from 25.9 KB to 77.9 KB, which is 0.88x the 89 KB regression the gate's ceiling-sensitivity check is sized on. About 11 KB more shrink would make that check refuse (exit 2) until the ceiling is re-pinned. The ceiling is the budget line, objectui#11762's, and this PR does not touch it.

## Not changed here: the two `*Inspector*` chunks still on the route

- **`ViewVariantInspector-*.js` is in the eager closure.** `views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` is the runtime ObjectView's view-editor rail, in the eager `ObjectView` chunk. It imports `views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ViewVariantInspector.tsx` statically. Measured with a temporary `React.lazy` on that edge (built, then restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): the closure loses 13,799 B gzipped more, and no `*Inspector*` chunk but `MetadataInspector` is eager. Headroom would then be about 91.7 KB, over the 89 KB the sensitivity check allows. The check would refuse until the ceiling is re-pinned, and that is the budget line this amendment rules out. That is a decision for the seat.
- **`MetadataInspector-*.js` is `views/MetadataInspector.tsx`,** the runtime debug panel (`MetadataPanel`, `useMetadataInspector`) that `ObjectView`, `PageView` and `RecordDetailView` mount. It is not Studio code. It matches the acceptance's `*Inspector*` glob by its name only.

## Studio and interface pages, in Chromium on the after build

- **`/_console/apps/demo_app/metadata/page/welcome`** (the page's Studio editor): `register-builtin-designers` and the inspector chunks load on that route. The page preview draws "Welcome / Hello from the welcome page." and the Properties form renders. The visible text is the same as on the before build. No page errors.
- **An interface page (`type: 'list'`, `interfaceConfig.source`):** `InterfaceListPage` loads and draws its own state ("Object Not Found", because the mock serves no object). The plain page loads neither chunk.

## The pin

`packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/pageRouteLoadsNoStudioChunks-12187.test.tsx` replaces `register-builtin-designers` and `InterfaceListPage` with factories that count their own evaluation, and imports the package entry. It asserts:
- neither module is evaluated by importing the entry, so a static edge back from `PageView` or a loader run at module scope again goes red;
- the first registry read loads and registers the designers, and later reads of any registry start no second load.

Ablations through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor went 1 to 0, was restored to the HEAD blob, and left `git diff HEAD` empty. The predicted direction was red both times, and both went red:
- the loader called at the entry's module scope again: `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, "the entry loaded the designers at its own module scope: expected 1 to be +0";
- `PageView`'s static `import { InterfaceListPage }` restored: `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, "a module in the static graph of the entry (PageView) imports InterfaceListPage statically: expected 1 to be +0".

The test imports app-shell source by relative path, so no `dist` is in its resolution path.

## Co-located test edits

- `page-kind-writing-end-9718`: the interface-mode case waits for the lazy mount (Testing Library's `waitFor`). The assertion is unchanged.
- `PageView.refreshInPlace-10519`: imports `../InterfaceListPage` at module scope, so the module loads in the import phase and the interface case's `waitFor` covers only the lazy edge (AGENTS.md 测试纪律).

## Tests and gates, at HEAD `0943b54`

- **vitest (through the verify lock):**
  - the pin, `entryRegistersBuiltinDesigners-11939`, `builtinDesigners.lateArrival-11939`, the four `designerRegistryMissing`, `designerRegistryPartial`, `designerRegistryPopulated` and three `lateRegistration-11939` files: 12 files, 25 tests passed;
  - every app-shell test file that names `preview-registry`, `inspector-registry`, `default-inspector-registry`, `InterfaceListPage` or `PageView`: `Test Files 120 passed (120)`, `Tests 1001 passed (1001)`;
  - the 19 console test files that import `@object-ui/app-shell`: `Test Files 19 passed (19)`, `Tests 162 passed (162)`.
- **`type-check`:** `@object-ui/app-shell` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose `include` is `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so it compiles the pin and the two edited tests) and `@object-ui/console`: both exit 0.
- **Builds:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2`: 34/34 tasks. Console `vite build`: exit 0, with every build guard in the config green (`assert-lazy-linter-stays-lazy`, `assert-types-zod-stays-lazy`, declared-lazy views, ineffective-dynamic-import ledger). `@object-ui/app-shell` rebuilt at HEAD: its published `dist/index.d.ts` is byte-identical to the base build's (`cmp` exit 0), so no exported type moved.
- **Gates, all exit 0:** `check:eager-closure` ("3126.7 KB gzipped across 70 of 2253 chunks", membership exact), `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:docs-route-closure`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)").
- **ESLint, narrowed and measured:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 8 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files gave 8 files, 0 errors and 27 warnings. Every warning is a `no-explicit-any` that was already there: the per-file counts equal the base's. The config has no type-aware linting (a grep for `projectService`, `typeChecked`, `tsconfigRootDir` or `parserOptions` exits 1; the `languageOptions` control exits 0). No `eslint-rules/*.js` reads the filesystem (exit 1, 23 rule files). So the diff cannot move another file's verdict. Repo-wide lint: NOT MEASURED, CI-owned.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12187-page-route-chunks.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch` and `@object-ui/console` `patch` (the console's published `dist` is chunked differently). No published export, prop or type changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's acceptance item 2 is a staging reading.** The seat takes it once cloud's pin carries this merge. Read against it: `ViewVariantInspector` and `MetadataInspector` will still match `*Inspector*` (see above). The local request count before content is 102, and 27 of those are API calls, so the staging figure depends on the backend's own calls and on item 3.
- **The first Studio open after a cold load.** The designers now start loading when the Studio route first reads a registry, not at boot. A reader shows its "designer missing" state until the chunk lands, the same state objectui#11939 already accepted for a cold deep link. A possible follow-up, not done here: the console's Studio route loaders could request the designers alongside the route chunk.
- **Imperative readers.** A host that reads a registry with `getMetadata*` / `listMetadata*` sees the built-ins from a read after the one that started the load. In this repository, every reader outside tests uses the hooks, apart from `ResourceEditPage`'s save handlers, which run after its own hooks have read.
- **Two boot requests are issued twice in the mock:** `/api/v1/runtime/config` (from `index.html`'s `applyEarlyBranding` and from app-shell's `initRuntimeConfig`) and `/api/v1/auth/me/localization`. objectui#5544's dedup covers an in-flight request, and this mock answers at once, so this is not a reading of staging. Not classed and not filed.
